thread:
Alex B.: Quick follow-up from today's postmortem — I want to capture owners and short timelines for the remediation items so we can track the recurring cache/eviction pattern. I'll list items; please claim or reassign.

Priya S.: Thanks Alex. I'll add a parent ticket for visibility after we allocate owners.

Alex B.: Item A: Deep-dive on eviction root cause + durable mitigation (metric + fix). Jira: INFR-5821. Suggested owner: someone from storage infra. Due: 1 week.

Taylor M.: I'll take INFR-5821. Plan: add eviction-rate telemetry, spike detector alert, and a short mitigation PR to reduce aggressive prefix invalidation. Target 2024-04-01.

Alex B.: Add acceptance criteria: dashboard, alert with runbook link, and PR merged to main.

Taylor M.: Will update ticket with that.

Alex B.: Item B: Rate-limit background vacuum/cleanup jobs and add graceful backoff. Jira: INFR-5822. Due: 2 weeks.

Jamie L.: I can own INFR-5822. Implementation: concurrency cap + jittered backoff + small feature flag to ramp. Will test on staging.

Irene K.: Router-level fallback to avoid routing to overloaded nodes would help. I can pair with Jamie for design review.

Jamie L.: Great. I'll create DOCS-410 for the design and request your review, @Irene K..

Irene K.: Review by EOD tomorrow works.

Alex B.: Item C: Runbook update and on-call checklist for this recurring issue. Jira: RUN-47. Owner: TBD.

Priya S.: I'll own RUN-47. Will enumerate steps for detection, immediate mitigations, and escalation path to platform oncall.

Alex B.: Make sure it links to INFR-5821 and INFR-5822. Also include a short customer-facing blurb.

Priya S.: Adding checklist snippet now:

```
- Open eviction-rate dashboard
- If eviction rate >5% sustained for 10m: run `jobsctl throttle --group=vacuum --pct=50`
- If latency >2s for 5m after throttle: reroute traffic from hot shards
- Escalate to platform oncall (paging policy) if unresolved after 15m
```

Taylor M.: Add note about deploy-related false positives; deployments often cause short spikes. I'll add a detection filter.

Alex B.: Item D: Automated rollback hook for config changes (safety net). Jira: PM-778. Owner: TBD.

Irene K.: Ops-automation can own the rollback hook. I can be accountable and shepherd the change. Need an infra engineer to implement hook wiring.

Jamie L.: I'll implement the hook code. Proposed RACI: Jamie (R), Irene (A), Alex (C), Priya (I).

Irene K.: That works. I'll add the RACI table to PM-778.

Alex B.: Item E: Customer communication snippet and FAQ. Jira: CX-122.

Priya S.: I'll draft CX-122 and link it to the postmortem. Short FAQ with mitigation steps and timeframe.

Alex B.: Ops-bot reminder: follow-up sync next Wed 10:00 UTC. Owners should be ready with progress updates.

ops-bot: Reminder set: Postmortem follow-up 1 2024-03-27 10:00 UTC.

Taylor M.: Quick ask: can we group these under a parent ticket to track recurrence-level work?

Priya S.: I created parent INFR-5900 to capture cross-cutting mitigations. Please link child tickets.

Taylor M.: Linked INFR-5821 to INFR-5900.

Jamie L.: Linked INFR-5822.

Priya S.: RUN-47, PM-778, CX-122 linked as well.

Alex B.: A couple of process notes: every ticket needs owner, due date, PR/branch, verification plan (including load test spec). If blocked, mark and call it out in the ticket comments and here.

Irene K.: For verification, I'll draft a load test that reproduces eviction at 2x normal write rate. Will attach to each ticket.

Taylor M.: I'll coordinate with SRE to run the test in staging once the telemetry branch is up.

Priya S.: I'll run a runbook walkthrough with platform oncall before the follow-up sync.

Alex B.: Thanks everyone. I'll update the postmortem doc with owner table and RACI snapshot. If you need to reassign, move the Jira and ping here. Please respect the due dates or flag blockers early. :thumbsup:
